description: The Moto G77 Power is a fairly dependable mid-range smartphone, but it does little to distinguish itself in a crowded segment. Its clean Android experience, smooth 120Hz refresh rate, decent everyday performance, solid build, and excellent battery life are all positives. However, the mediocre LCD panel, average cameras, ageing Dimensity 6400 chipset, repetitive design, and disappointing software update policy make the Rs. 25,999 price difficult to justify.
title: Moto G77 Power Review: Same Old Design, One Big Strength

description: The three smartphones differ notably in display technology, battery capacity and software support. The Realme 16x 5G combines a 144Hz LCD panel with a 7,000mAh battery and 45W charging. The Redmi Note 17 5G offers a Full-HD+ AMOLED display, an 8,000mAh battery and the longest software support. The Moto G77 Power includes an ultrawide camera and 32-megapixel selfie shooter. All three support 5G connectivity, while their prices start between Rs. 25,999 and Rs. 27,999 in India.
title: Realme 16x 5G vs Redmi Note 17 5G vs Moto G77 Power: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Telegram bots are designed to manage a range of tasks. Bots can see a user's public name, username and profile picture of a user, but it can not access the phone number or last seen status of a user unless the user chooses to share that information. Here we have listed some Telegram bots that users in India can try.
title: Best Telegram Bots for Productivity You Can Use in India 2026

description: In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has moved beyond flagship smartphones, and now AI-powered tools are offered on phones across the mid-range segment as well. Handsets like the OnePlus Nord CE 6, Motorola Edge 70, and Redmi Note 17 offer AI-assisted photo editing, image enhancements, and Google Gemini integration. Even though most of the features are not on-device but cloud-based, they can still improve creativity and enhance productivity.
title: Best Smartphones with AI Features Under Rs. 30,000 in India: OnePlus Nord CE 6, Motorola Edge 70 and More

description: WhatsApp recently started allowing users to reserve their WhatsApp Usernames in India. The soon-to-be-rolled-out WhatsApp Usernames functionality will let you search for other known and unknown users by simply typing their usernames in a dedicated search box. The feature is said to work similarly to how you search for your friends and other users on Instagram, Facebook, X, or Reddit. The functionality will bridge the gap between WhatsApp as a messaging platform and other social media platforms.
title: WhatsApp Usernames Explained: What It Is, Benefits, How to Use, and More

description: WhatsApp lets you use Meta AI-powered tools to generate custom stickers if you wish to send them to your friends, family members, colleagues, and other contacts on India's 80th Independence Day. Sending a custom sticker to your friends and family members on WhatsApp adds a personal touch to your Independence Day greetings and messages. Moreover, the stickers are better for conveying your patriotism compared to a simple text message, as it allows you to express your emotions more colorfully and uniquely. A sticker with the Indian Tricolour in WhatsApp stickers will also give them a much-needed festive touch.
title: How To Create Independence Day Stickers on WhatsApp: A Step-by-Step Guide
